_comment: IAM for the Directus ECS task — Yiji CRM, us-east-2.
TWO ROLES ARE INVOLVED and they are not interchangeable:
taskRoleArn      -> what the RUNNING CONTAINER may do  (S3 uploads)
executionRoleArn -> what ECS does ON ITS BEHALF to start it (pull, logs)
A task-role permission will not fix a startup failure, and vice versa.
WHY THE EXECUTION EXTRA EXISTS: the task definition sets
does NOT grant logs:CreateLogGroup. Without it the task fails at START with a
CannotStartContainerError and writes no logs — so the one place you would look
for the reason is the thing that could not be created. Either add this policy
or pre-create /ecs/yiji-crm-directus in CloudWatch by hand.
Scope note: S3 access is limited to this one bucket. Directus needs no other
AWS API, so nothing else is granted.
